Sybil resistance through stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a ferrous-hard bond in the grove registry, forfeited if peers detect duplicate identities. An attacker must acquire many opals and lock real value per identity, so forging a thousand sybils burns a thousand bonds plus credential costs, far exceeding any reward.
